== Strategy ==

Strategy :
You Should be able to flip your objective in the first turn. The key figure here is Lott dot who makes the game much easier with his card pulling ability. Then simply pull out Naboo location deploy there and drain your opponent from there. If your lucky you will be able to deploy maul on lading site and deploy a presence of the force there than on the next turn you will be able to put a nice drain for 7J  Try to get Baskol out so opponent will lose 2 another force from your Naboo Loacations you ControlJ I think this deck should perform well against any deckJ I will appreciate some suggestionsJ
